e_nominal.basis: OI-2 da dong o d2_protocol 1.3.0. Bai Rodrigues TU MAU THUAN ve loai pin; 3/4 bang chung doc lap chi ve TB47D, va 99.9 la gia tri NHO HON nen la huong bao thu. Chi tiet: reports/parameter_table.md muc 1.1.
e_nominal.mandatory_sensitivity: BAT BUOC chay lai toan bo o san pham D4 voi 129.96 Wh va bao ket luan thay doi the nao (§8 muc 3).

kappa_temperature.limitation_to_state_in_paper: Dai van hanh M100 la -10..40 C, dai hieu chinh cua Kim chi 4.5-18.4 C. PHAN LON vung van hanh nam ngoai dai hop le. Mo hinh hien KHONG mo ta duoc anh huong nhiet do tren phan lon dai van hanh; ket qua lien quan nhiet do trinh bay nhu PHAN TICH DO NHAY, khong phai du bao.
kappa_temperature.rationale: Quy tac cu (kappa = 1 cho MOI nhiet do ngoai dai) SAI o phia lanh: tai 4.4 C no nhay tu 0.920 len 1.000, tuc cang lanh cang gia dinh pin cang khoe. Pin LiPo lanh thi tut dung luong, nen quy tac cu lam E_available bi tinh THUA -> bien du tru ao -> cho bay chuyen khong du pin. Day dung loai loi ma de tai sinh ra de chong. Quy tac moi giu o gia tri bien lanh 0.9203: khong ngoai suy (§5.4 cam), lien tuc, va bao thu.
kappa_temperature.rule:
T < 4.5    -> kappa = poly(4.5) = 0.9203     # giu o bien lanh
4.5<=T<=18.4 -> kappa = min(1, poly(T))
T > 18.4   -> kappa = 1.0                    # chan tren
kappa_temperature.upper_clamp_reason: Da thuc goc tra ve >1 trong khoang ~15.8-75.2 C, dat 1.089 tai 45.5 C — tuc khang dinh pin chua nhieu nang luong hon muc danh dinh cua chinh no. Vo ly ve vat ly.

soc_soh_convention.meaning: dien tich hien co so voi dung luong luc pin con moi
soc_soh_convention.warning: P§4.4 canh bao hai dai luong nay duoc dinh nghia khac nhau trong tai lieu; ghep nham cap se DEM DUNG LUONG HIEN TAI HAI LAN. Quy uoc tren phai viet ro trong bai, khong de ngam hieu.
